interface.intent_parameter: requestJSON: String; private AppShortcut presets supply fixed literal frame, no source/grant/destination/health fields
interface.execution: Retain private native target minimum17 build metadata. iOS26+ supportedModes.background only with availability guard; openAppWhenRun=false compatibility property for earlierSDK/OS. Requested actualproof iOS26.5 Simulator only; iOS17 execution unqualified. Separate private ColdHostProbe target; no production/minimumOS admission change.
interface.request_wire_policy: New private canonical ASCII JSON grammar, fixed field order, compact separators, exactly quoted ASCII schema/case enumerations, canonical integer tokens only (0 or nonzero digits, no decimal/exponent/-0/boolean). Unknown keys/duplicate/escape aliases/nonASCII/string normalization/extra whitespace reject schema_invalid. Whole UTF8 byte bound precedes parse and engine/resource creation. Version1; sequence0..1023; deadline0..5000 milliseconds. Deadline0 returns expired before engine or acquire. Native monotonic remaining deadline begins at OS perform entry and is rechecked before creating host, before native acquire, on JS callback, and before result; no caller-supplied epoch, wallclock conversion or authorization claim. This is reviewed new candidate policy, not historical JSON equivalence.
interface.authority: Only fixed healthfree synthetic resource; no native source/grant catalog authority or permission expansion; sender/case/sequence are protocol labels, not authentication.
interface.swift_native_seam: Swift ColdProbeIntent.perform -> ColdProbeBridge.start(requestJSON, completion) with cancellation handler -> lazily initialized RCTReactNativeFactory/RCTHost -> typed private pending mailbox/cancellation/result acknowledgment -> Swift fixed IntentResult/String and safe counter report. No invoke from UIApplication launch callback or test direct perform.
interface.js_interface: New cold-intent-probe.ts validates admitted primitive frame and registers one CandidateColdProbe callable module. It uses exactly accepted inspectCandidate/CandidateSession with Layer over unchanged NativeProbe.acquire/inspect/release. Mailbox bootstrap and nativecancel survive runtime loading; cancellation before loading acknowledgment prevents stale acquire. Late callbacks rejected by sequence/deadline; native owned finalizers always acknowledged before completion/host teardown. One headless engine at a time, credit2/queue4 bounds, no React root/AppRegistry/native view.
interface.failure_policy: Fixed codes only: schema_invalid, frame_limit, expired, backpressure, cancelled, runtime_unavailable, ingress_unavailable, probe_assertion. No raw JS/native/Effect errors, intent request echo, source IDs, data or user store.
interface.native_lifecycle: Actor/serial queue owns runtime/request/credits and exactly-once continuation. OS native Task cancellation forwards private cancel without returning before accepted resource release_ack; watchdog fails fixed runtime_unavailable rather than manufacture ack. Destroying/killing process cannot be claimed graceful ack. Exact engine start/peakRSS/credits/cleanup measurements recorded separately as safe counters.
interface.project_seam: New ColdHostProbe app target in existing project excludes AppDelegate.swift, uses headless @main UIApplicationDelegate inside ColdProbeIntent.swift, reuses unchanged NativeProbe.mm and pinned Pod frameworks/locks; separate ColdProbeIntentUITests target uses ColdProbeIntentTests.swift without @testable import. Existing HostProbe target, old ten-case fixture, HostProbe.tsx autorun entry, scripts/build.mjs and dist assets remain unchanged. Dedicated proposed scripts/build-cold-intent.mjs is invoked by allowed run-cold-intent-probe.sh only after ROOT approves exact additional path and common frozen build window.
